boothNumberingNotes: Booth numbers rise with tier and with distance from the Main Entrance: 100-141 Diamond/Platinum (plus a few Gold/media) in Halls A-C (Diamond 115-124 in the centre diagonal); 144-191 Gold and Platinum in Hall 1 (Platinum 152/153/163/172/182/191 on the Hall A side wall); 192-257 Silver in Hall 2 (Honeycomb Hub); 258-327 Silver in Hall 3 and lower Hall 4 (Amber Hive); 330-375 Start-up (plus a few Silver/media) in Cosmic Canyon (Halls 4-5). In Halls 1-5 booths come in 2x2 islands: odd numbers on the upper row, even on the lower (e.g. 311/313 over 310/312). Halls A-C are a diagonal grid of single island booths. Booth 261 is drawn but unassigned in both sources. Hall letter for booths in Halls A-C is inferred (no internal walls drawn); zone is derived from the map's fill colour.
